test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.**

In spite of a steep hike in the prices of crude oil, the government __did not rise__ the price of fuel.
solution:
The correct answer is- 'did not raise.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence the **verb **(*rise*) is an **intransitive verb**. It means it is never followed by a **direct object **(the *price of fuel*).
 
• As there is a **direct object **(the *price of fuel*) we need a **transitive verb **in the above sentence.
 
• So we must use the verb (**raise**) in place of '**rise**' to make the sentence grammatically correct.
